definitions.explanation: A small drop of water; individual droplets of liquid water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{水滴|すいてき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: There are water droplets on the leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}って→伝う：28247_tsutau⟧{水滴|すいてき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちていく→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: Water drops are rolling down the window glass.
I woke up to the sound of water drops falling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}くと→置く：01092_oku⟧、⟦コップ→コップ：00862_koppu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{水滴|すいてき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: When you set down a cold drink, water droplets form on the outside of the glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされた→照らす：04669_terasu⟧⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水滴|すいてき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{宝石|ほうせき}→宝石：03619_houseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The water droplets on the flower petals, illuminated by the morning light, were sparkling like jewels.

notes:
Individual drops of water, whether from rain, condensation, or dripping. Composed of {水|すい} (water) + ⟦{滴|てき}→〜滴：04014_teki⟧ (drop). Used in scientific, poetic, and descriptive writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水滴|すいてき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: a water drop falls
- {水滴|すいてき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: water drops form (on a surface)
- {水滴|すいてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧: to wipe off water drops

USAGE:
- Condensation on cold surfaces (glasses, windows)
- Morning dew on plants
- Water dripping from a faucet or ceiling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雫|しずく}→雫：19349_shizuku⟧: drop (more literary/poetic)
- ⟦{露|つゆ}→露：02233_tsuyu⟧: dew
- ⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧: one drop (emphasizes a single drop)
